sources.officialProductEvidence: The official page confirms the QST 94 Lilac product, article reference L49189300+, sizes 156/164/172/180/188 cm, 94 mm waist, intermediate skill level, Freeride Profile, 13.5 m displayed radius, 131-94-117 mm displayed sidecut, Full Poplar Woodcore, Ti Binding Reinforcement, Basalt Superlight Fibers, Fiberglass, Full Sandwich Sidewalls and Cork Damplifier.
sources.seasonEvidence: The Salomon 2026/27 product lineup includes QST 94; the official product page itself does not print a season label.

catalogueAndTestReport.evidence: The retailer's 2026/27 staff test report lists per-length sidecut, radius, and ski-only mass (1/2 pair) for sizes 156/164/172/180/188. It identifies the 172 cm ski as 1700 g. The published 188 cm weight appears anomalous (2940 g) and is intentionally not mapped.

mappingNotes: The official Salomon product page and 2026/27 retailer test-report table agree on the dimensions and radii. The report's 188 cm weight is anomalous, so only the unambiguous 172 cm per-ski weight is mapped.
imageRights: The official product image URL is a source reference only; no explicit reuse license verified.
